clue.text: End of the line for a Roman god

explanation.definitionFit: A railway's final station is its terminal stop, and the Romans worshipped a deity of boundary stones under this name.

clue.text: Little thanks to an unconscious state in Washington

parts.note: ta is a short informal British way of saying thanks
a coma is a prolonged unconscious state

explanation.surface: A grudging word of gratitude given to a senator dozing in Congress.
explanation.walkthrough: 'state in Washington' looks like the definition, but 'state' belongs to the wordplay; the definition is a place 'in Washington' state.
explanation.definitionFit: Tacoma is a port city located in Washington State.

clue.text: Negligent about failure to make a hit

parts.note: re is a formal word for about or concerning
to miss is to fail to hit the target

explanation.surface: Someone is careless about striking the ball.
explanation.definitionFit: Being remiss means failing to take proper care with a duty.

clue.text: Girl one's able to convert

parts.note: one is I as a Roman numeral, and 's stands for is, giving I's

indicators.note: to convert means to change form, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A girl is capable of converting someone to her faith.
explanation.definitionFit: Isabel is a female first name, a form of Elizabeth.

clue.text: Where coal is found near Swansea?

definitions.text: Where coal is found near Swansea?

parts.words: Where coal is found near Swansea?
parts.note: coal lies below ground, and Neath is a Welsh mining town near Swansea, so the coal is literally below that town

explanation.walkthrough: Neath is a town in south Wales close to Swansea, once in the heart of the coalfield.
explanation.definitionFit: Coal seams lie beneath the surface, and the phrase splits into 'below Neath', the town.

clue.text: Bird for one on disciplinary duty in the Services

definitions.text: one on disciplinary duty in the Services

explanation.walkthrough: In Britain a redcap is a member of the Royal Military Police, named for the red cover on the cap.
explanation.definitionFit: Redcap is an old name for the goldfinch, and British military police wear red-topped caps, giving them the nickname.

clue.text: Clearly not at a loss for words

definitions.text: Clearly not at a loss for words

parts.words: Clearly not at a loss for words
parts.note: describes someone who speaks fluently and expresses themselves with clarity

explanation.definitionFit: A fluent, articulate speaker is never short of words and expresses ideas clearly.

clue.text: Cliquey type, one may gather

parts.note: 'one may gather' reads as 'one supposes', but also as the Scottish clans gathering, of which this person is a member

explanation.definitionFit: A member of a Scottish clan belongs to a close kin group, which gathers at Highland meetings.

clue.text: Part of a flower the odd painter finds hard to finish

indicators.note: to finish means the next piece goes at the very end
odd means strange, so the letters of painter are rearranged

parts.note: H is the pencil-grade abbreviation for hard

explanation.surface: An eccentric artist struggles to complete a picture.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The odd painter' reads as an eccentric artist, but 'odd' is the anagram signal; 'finds hard to finish' looks like struggling, yet it just puts the hard pencil grade last.
explanation.definitionFit: The perianth is the outer envelope of a bloom, the petals and sepals together.

clue.text: Raider getting direct order initially

parts.note: to direct troops is to command them

indicators.note: initially asks for the opening letter of the word order

explanation.surface: A soldier carries out a raid after receiving an explicit instruction.
explanation.definitionFit: A commando is a soldier trained for swift raids behind enemy lines.

clue.text: Gasbag's content to gossip?

explanation.walkthrough: 'Gasbag' reads as a chatterer, but the first sense is a balloon, whose contents are heated air; the second definition is the chatter itself.
explanation.definitionFit: A balloon is filled with heated air, and idle empty chatter is likewise called this.

clue.text: Smooth operators in large numbers around the old city

indicators.note: around means the first piece encloses the second here

parts.note: large numbers of people are masses
Ur is the ancient Mesopotamian city, the crossword's stock old city

explanation.surface: Slick dealmakers are thronging in great crowds round a historic town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Smooth operators' sounds like conmen, but these are people who smooth muscles by rubbing them.
explanation.definitionFit: Massage therapists knead and rub the body, literally smoothing it with their hands.

clue.text: Power that gives us airs of a sort

indicators.note: of a sort suggests a loose version, so these letters are rearranged into another order

explanation.surface: A great nation puts on graces for our benefit.
explanation.definitionFit: A power in the political sense is a strong nation state, as the largest country on Earth is.

clue.text: The work of an eccentric builder, perhaps

definitions.text: The work of an eccentric builder, perhaps

parts.words: The work of an eccentric builder, perhaps
parts.note: a folly is an ornamental building with no use, so building one is literally a foolish deed

explanation.walkthrough: In Britain a folly is a useless ornamental structure, such as a fake ruin built on an estate.
explanation.definitionFit: A foolish deed is a rash act, and a whimsical garden tower is also called a folly.

clue.text: One who has come down in the world relatively

definitions.text: One who has come down in the world relatively

parts.words: One who has come down in the world relatively
parts.note: 'come down in the world' suggests lost status, but the person has come down a family line from a relative

explanation.definitionFit: Someone born into a later generation of a family line comes down from their ancestors.

clue.text: Did relief work

parts.note: reads as aiding victims of disaster, but relief here is raised decoration on a surface

explanation.definitionFit: Raising a design so it stands out from metal or leather is creating a relief pattern.

clue.text: Search for "The Monarch of the Glen "?

definitions.text: Search for "The Monarch of the Glen "?

parts.words: Search for "The Monarch of the Glen "?
parts.note: The Monarch of the Glen is Landseer's painting of a red deer, so searching for that subject is a chase after a male deer

explanation.walkthrough: 'The Monarch of the Glen' is an 1851 painting by Edwin Landseer of a Highland red deer.
explanation.definitionFit: A pursuit of a male red deer with hounds is a hunt for the beast in Landseer's famous picture.

clue.text: Evergreen round Hero's hero .. …

parts.note: a round shape is the letter O
in Greek myth Leander swam the Hellespont nightly to his beloved Hero

explanation.surface: A lasting figure circles around the hero of Hero's story.
explanation.definitionFit: Oleander is a Mediterranean shrub that keeps its leaves all year.

clue.text: Outcome of cutting up rough, possibly

definitions.text: Outcome of cutting up rough, possibly

parts.words: Outcome of cutting up rough, possibly
parts.note: 'cutting up rough' is an idiom for turning violent, read literally as slashing someone roughly, leaving them maimed

explanation.definitionFit: Maiming or disfiguring a body is the result of savage slashing.

clue.text: … and Farrar's hero gets 150 start from the good man

indicators.note: start places this number at the front of the name

parts.note: CL is 150 in Roman numerals
Eric is the boy hero of F. W. Farrar's novel Eric, or Little by Little

explanation.surface: Continuing the previous clue, Farrar's boy hero gets a head start in a race from a kindly man.
explanation.walkthrough: The ellipses carry on from the previous clue. 'The good man' sounds like a general compliment, but a churchman is meant; Farrar was a Victorian clergyman who wrote school stories.
explanation.definitionFit: A cleric is a churchman, a man of God, hence 'the good man'.

clue.text: Lear's daughter taking in a leading statesman

indicators.note: taking in means the first piece holds the second inside it

parts.note: Regan is one of King Lear's daughters in Shakespeare

explanation.surface: One of King Lear's daughters welcomes a prominent politician.
explanation.definitionFit: Ronald Reagan was the fortieth American president, a prominent political figure.

clue.text: Sewer's cramp?

parts.note: a sewer makes loops of thread with a needle, and the same word names a sharp pain in the side

explanation.definitionFit: A single loop of thread in sewing shares its name with a sudden muscle pain in the side.

clue.text: Sweet offering Tagore composed

indicators.note: composed means put together, so the poet's name is rearranged

explanation.surface: Rabindranath Tagore writes a pleasant offering, perhaps a poem.
explanation.walkthrough: Tagore was an Indian poet, so 'composed' looks like writing verse; the result is a syrup flavoured with almonds.
explanation.definitionFit: Orgeat is a sweet almond syrup used in cocktails and desserts.

clue.text: A fiery leader facile and well heeled

indicators.note: leader asks for the first letter of the word fiery

parts.note: facile in the sense of easy, flowing, means fluent

explanation.surface: A fiery boss who talks easily and is also rich.
explanation.definitionFit: Well-heeled people are wealthy, which is what affluent means.

clue.text: Nothing wrong with the volume

parts.note: reads as a sound engineer's approval of loudness, and as the everyday phrase for something seeming satisfactory

explanation.definitionFit: When a plan seems acceptable, people say it gives a good impression to the ear, literally a fine noise level.

clue.text: See 24
Over-fond person little Dorothy has a way with

parts.note: Dot is a short form of the name Dorothy
Rd is the abbreviation for road, a way

explanation.surface: Little Dorothy gets her own way with something.
explanation.definitionFit: A dotard is a feeble old person, especially one doting foolishly through age.

clue.text: It's hard on poor Cynthia making such bloomer

indicators.note: on in an across clue means the first piece comes before the next

parts.note: H is the pencil-grade abbreviation for hard

indicators.note: poor suggests something in bad shape, so the name is rearranged

explanation.surface: Life is tough for unfortunate Cynthia, who made such a blunder.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bloomer' looks like a blunder, but it means a flowering plant.
explanation.definitionFit: A hyacinth is a spring bulb that bears spikes of fragrant flowers.
